transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Metrobús connects the airport with central Mexico City. Boarding is at door 7 of Terminal 1 and door 2 of Terminal 2. Payment is by Metrobús card, which can be bought and topped up at machines in the boarding and drop-off areas of both terminals. Services run from 04:30 to midnight Monday to Saturday, and from 05:00 to midnight on Sundays and public holidays.

terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.text: The free Aerotrén carries passengers between Terminals 1 and 2 daily from 05:00 to 23:00. A boarding pass must be presented to travel. Dogs are allowed only in cages and in empty carriages; eating, drinking and smoking are prohibited on the train.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: In Terminal 1, MEXICANA DE LOCKERS offers round-the-clock luggage storage on the ground level, unit E-41. In Terminal 2, VIAJES KOKAI locations in units ALL45 and ALL46 are available round the clock on the ground level.
